heroSection.title: Bank of Uganda Data Portal
heroSection.description:
Welcome to the **Bank of Uganda Data Portal**—your central access point for Uganda’s official macroeconomic and financial statistics. The portal provides timely, reliable, and user-friendly access to interactive dashboards covering key economic and financial indicators.

Data are presented as time series across five areas: Monetary and Financial Sector Statistics, External Sector Statistics, Real Sector Statistics, Selected Macroeconomic Indicators, and Payments Data and Statistics. Users can explore datasets through dynamic visualisations, select indicators, adjust time periods, and customise data frequency.

Additional reports are accessible via the [**Bank of Uganda Publications**](https://www.bou.or.ug/publications) and [**open data platforms**](https://cb-uganda.opendataforafrica.org/).

For assistance, please use the Data Help section or contact **statistics_disseminate@bou.or.ug**.
